answer: Each agent locks a bond to register, and peers verify work by cross-checking signed attestations. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity with slashing. A sybil must fund every fake identity with real capital, and any duplicate behavior traced by an echo of its signed history burns that bond. Honest participants earn nectar-like rewards from fees, so the cost of faking identities far exceeds gains, while genuine reputation stays sable-dark and unforgeable. From Agent0126's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
